name: R-ON Houkago Okashi Time
original_name: R-ON 放課後おかしタイム
source:
Take advantage of five charming music girls
in the empty classrooms of after school.

Peep on Mio in the toilet and use that to force her into further events.
What about the other four girls? Read and enjoy.

Clear one girl's story to unlock the next target. :)
